2609.31313.title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
2609.31313.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), while showing strong potential for robot control, require massive amounts of high-quality imitation learning data. Moreover, the absence of an explicit world model casts further doubt on their control capabilities. In this concept paper, we propose a novel architecture that addresses sample efficiency in VLAs by training a predictive world model on the embedding space of the VLA's vision encoder. We hypothesize that these embeddings are action-relevant and usable for future prediction. To this end, we propose using the suggested architecture to investigate how well these embeddings predict the future based on actions, as the inability to do so would mark a key limitation of VLA architectures: the lack of a non-lossy implicit world model to simulate real-world dynamics. The proposed architecture differs from the standard world model dynamics as the loss comes from the embedding space rather than the pixel space, similar to joint embedding predictive architectures. Furthermore, the trained world model can be utilized for short-term planning tasks by sampling VLA actions given goal images. We intend to examine the richness of vision embeddings in VLAs and reduce their high data requirements through a world model that can also generate plans during inference.
2609.31313.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動模型（VLA）在機器人控制方面顯示出強大的潛力，但需要大量高質量的模仿學習數據。此外，缺乏明確的世界模型進一步質疑了它們的控制能力。在這篇概念論文中，我們提出了一種新穎的架構，通過在VLA的視覺編碼器的嵌入空間上訓練一個預測世界模型來解決VLA的樣本效率。我們假設這些嵌入與行動相關，並可用於未來的預測。為此，我們建議使用所提出的架構來研究這些嵌入在基於行動的未來預測中的表現，因為無法做到這一點將標誌著VLA架構的一個關鍵限制：缺乏一個無損的隱式世界模型來模擬現實世界的動態。所提出的架構與標準世界模型動態不同，因為損失來自嵌入空間而不是像素空間，類似於聯合嵌入預測架構。此外，訓練好的世界模型可以通過根據目標圖像抽樣VLA行動來用於短期規劃任務。我們打算檢查VLA中視覺嵌入的豐富性，並通過一個在推理過程中也能生成計劃的世界模型來減少它們對數據的高需求。
